senses: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.31
a descendant of Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan and grandson of king Saul
a Benjamite, father of Jeziel and Pelet who were two of David's men who joined him at Ziklag
overseer of the royal treasures in the reign of David

strongs.def: Azmaveth, the name of three Israelites and of a place in Palestine
strongs.from: from H5794 (עַז) and H4194 (מָוֶת); strong one of death
